build.desc: Write new code or features: implement, add, create, refactor or script something that does not exist yet.

debug.desc: Something is broken: find the cause of an error, crash, failing test or regression and fix it.

review.desc: Check finished work: review a diff or pull request, audit, verify a claim, confirm that something is done.

plan.desc: Decide before building: design, architecture, strategy, a spec, a roadmap, or an approval to ship.

coordinate.desc: Organise several agents or sessions: delegate work, run workers in parallel, hold a debate between peers.

tasks.desc: Manage the task list: backlog, to-do items, what comes next, picking up a handoff.

memory.desc: Store or recall what was decided or claimed before: remember a fact, write a recap, read project memory.

research.desc: Find something out: look up facts or docs, compare options, explain how or why, map an unfamiliar codebase.

wiki.desc: Work on the document corpus: wiki pages, the vault, Obsidian notes, ingesting or converting documents.

device.desc: Touch the phone or its runtime: Termux, Android, adb, the NPU, an APK, installing something on the device.
